# FLX-7009: accuracy store entry is a link or the wrong type of file

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

The accuracy store keeps each record as a regular file in `<state-dir>/accuracy/predictions` or `<state-dir>/accuracy/verdicts`, and it never follows a symbolic link at or below `<state-dir>/accuracy`: a link could send a registration into a file outside the store, or into another prediction's sealed record. The store found a link, a directory or another special file where a record or one of those three directories belongs, and refused it. Nothing was read or written through it, and the file a link points at is untouched. (A link where a verdict is about to be written is replaced by the verdict instead, again without touching the file it points at.) Remove the entry and run the command again. To keep the store somewhere else, pass that place as `--state-dir` rather than linking into the store.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7009
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
